research.facts:
Final Hours — Last Day for Unrestricted Recruiting Contact
**Source Search:** NCAA softball recruiting calendar 2026-27, recruiting rules coverage
**Verified Facts:**
| Fact | Confidence | Source/Notes |
|------|-----------|--------------|
| Nov. 24 is the final day for unrestricted contact (calls, texts, email) with any recruit | HIGH | Multiple recruiting calendar sites agree (ncsasports.org, nextcommit.ai, readthefield.com, softballbound.com) |
| NCAA softball recruiting shutdown Nov. 25-29 — zero contact permitted | HIGH | Confirmed by multiple calendar sources |
| Transfer portal opens Dec. 1 | HIGH | Confirmed through multiple pipeline runs and calendar sources |
| Dead period Dec. 9-12 | HIGH | Confirmed by multiple sources (some say Dec. 8-12; conservative framing Dec. 9-12) |
| Coaches actively making last-minute recruiting calls on shutdown eve | MEDIUM | Standard coaching practice confirmed by multiple coaches on record in prior reporting |
| Last-minute commitments often announced on final contact day | MEDIUM | Historical pattern well-documented in softball recruiting coverage |
**Key Context:**
The sequence is unprecedented in its compression: unrestricted contact → 5-day shutdown → Dec. 1 portal → Dec. 9-12 dead period. Programs that failed to lock in commitments today enter a 14-day scramble with limited communication windows.

Arizona's Ace Hunt — 7 Days Until the Portal
**Source Search:** Arizona softball fall results, D1Softball POY, transfer portal Dec 2026
**Verified Facts:**
| Fact | Confidence | Source/Notes |
|------|-----------|--------------|

| Arizona lost its D1Softball National POY pitcher (Torres) to Texas Tech | HIGH | Confirmed in multiple pipeline runs (Nov 14-23); Texas Tech No.1 transfer class SA includes Torres |
| OSU's Saylor Davis expected to enter portal Dec. 1 with three years of eligibility | HIGH | SI article confirms portal entry plan; prior pipeline runs confirmed (Nov 22, Nov 23) |
| Ole Miss and Auburn also hunting portal pitchers | HIGH | Confirmed through multiple pipeline runs |
| Transfer portal opens Dec. 1 | HIGH | Multiple sources |
| Dead period Dec. 9-12 compresses actionable window | HIGH | Calendar confirmed |
| Arizona coach Caitlin Lowe led team to 15-2 fall record | HIGH | Multiple prior pipeline runs confirmed |
| Dec. 1 portal gives programs fewer than 9 days before dead period | HIGH | Simple calendar math: Dec. 1 to Dec. 8 = 8 days |
**Key Context:**
Arizona is one of the clearest examples of a program that needs portal help to reach its ceiling. Without Torres (D1Softball POY), the rotation lacks a proven ace. Regan Shockey (Big 12 DPOY) handles the defense, but pitching is the ceiling variable.
